shellCommands.command: ls -la && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json
cat index.html src/*.ts* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; ls node_modules | grep -iE "chart|yagr|uplot|d3|highcharts"; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -30
npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.11.0 dependencies optionalDependencies peerDependenciesMeta exports 2>&1 | head -80

npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.11.0 2>&1 | tail -8; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules 2>&1; npm ls @gravity-ui/charts 2>&1 | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/index.d.ts; git status --short

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && cat plugins/yagr/index.js plugins/gravity-charts/index.js; cat types.d.ts | head -90; grep -n "registerPlugins\|plugins" libs/settings/settings.d.ts; cat components/ChartKit.d.ts | head -30
ls; ls types; cat types/widget.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat components/ChartKit.js | head -80; cat libs/settings/settings.js | head -40; ls components/ ; cat types/index.d.ts | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat chartkit/build/libs/settings/mergeSettingStrategy.js; grep -n "SegmentedRadioGroup\|RadioButton" uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; ls /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/*/*/dataviz/references; sed -n 1,80p /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/*/*/dataviz/references/palette.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && node /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/*/*/dataviz/scripts/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a" --mode light 2>&1 | tail -25; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls chartkit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "libraryConfig" chartkit/README.md chartkit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js | head -90; grep -n "export type ChartData\b" -A 40 charts/build/types/chart/chart.d.ts | head -70
ls chartkit/build/docs/guides; find charts -name "*.d.ts" -path "*types*" | head -20; grep -rn "type: 'datetime'\|ChartXAxis = " charts/build --include=*.d.ts | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls charts/build; grep -rln "interface ChartXAxis\|type ChartXAxis" charts/build --include=*.d.ts | head;
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts && ls; grep -rln "ChartXAxis" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs && grep -rn "export type ChartXAxis = \|export type ChartData = \|export type LineSeries\b\|export type LineSeriesData\|export type ChartLegend\b" types | head;
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

grep -o 'src="[^"]*"\|href="[^"]*"' dist/index.html; ls -S dist/assets | head -5; E=$(grep -o 'assets/index-[^"]*\.js' dist/index.html); echo entry=$E; grep -c "uPlot\|u-over" dist/$E; grep -o 'import("[^"]*\(Yagr\|GravityCharts\)[^"]*")' dist/assets/*.js | sort -u; git status --short
rm -rf dist && git status --short
